title: Staging Slugify Utility
description: Disposable V2.1 staging acceptance project: a tiny zero-dependency TypeScript utility with tests, run on Node's built-in TypeScript support.
businessObjectives: Exercise one genuine Claude Code worker task and the independent QA lifecycle in staging

functionalRequirements.text: A slugify(text) function that lower-cases, transliterates nothing, replaces runs of non-alphanumeric characters with a single hyphen and trims leading/trailing hyphens
slugify throws a TypeError when the argument is not a string

nonFunctionalRequirements.text: No third-party dependencies; tests use node:test and node:assert

technicalConstraints: TypeScript run directly by Node.js 26 (built-in type stripping)

acceptanceCriteria.text: FR-1 and FR-2 are implemented and covered by tests
